case.pattern_description: Determined by deterministic signatures and LLM verification.

final.reason: R9: Customer confirmed transaction was unauthorized.

sar.reason: Policy threshold triggered mandatory SAR filing.
sar.narrative: The SAR concerns case HHG-004 involving a customer whose identity status is verified. The trigger was transaction TXN-004 which received a risk score of 0.85. No specific flagged transaction details were provided, but the system noted one device relationship linking the customer to prior activity. The prior closed case HIST-991 was adjudicated as fraud with a card‑not‑present pattern and a relevance note indicating a shared device profile detected. The presence of a single device relationship and zero connected cards suggests the same device was used across multiple accounts. This linkage, combined with the high risk score, raises suspicion that the current activity may be an extension of the fraudulent behavior observed in HIST-991. Therefore the activity is considered suspicious because the same device is being reused despite a verified identity, indicating potential circumvention of controls.

containment_steps: Place temporary security authorization hold on transaction TXN-004
Issue immediate network-level block on all linked card PANs

customer_communication.message_copy: Did you attempt a purchase of $150.00? Reply YES if this was you, or NO if you did not make this purchase.

financial_remediation: Initiate chargeback procedures for identified exposure

stop_reason: Policy thresholds met or maximum evidence gathered.
